purpose: Prevent land-vehicle rollback from turning into a tank-only alternate history. Every campaign re-adjudication must account for naval, air, radar, fire-control, logistics and intelligence interactions on the same dated timeline.

naval: amphibious lift and landing craft availability
ASW escort, Tokai, Ka-go where physically present
fire_control: naval fire-control radar and optical directors
logistics: recovery rights after battlefield possession changes

interaction_rules: Do not add a vehicle-quality bonus independently if the existing settlement already credited improved artillery, engineers, radar or logistics for the same tactical effect.
Naval gunfire can suppress or destroy armor/AT/artillery, but only if target acquisition, communications, ammunition and firing time exist.
Radar improves detection or fire-direction only within its actual frequency, geometry, operator skill and network throughput; do not turn fixed radar into omniscient CIC/GCI.
Better Japanese radar/fire control can increase US aircraft/ship losses while also making the radar itself a higher-priority suppression target.
A prolonged island battle that crosses another sunset automatically opens a separate night-action gate.
A longer campaign consumes more naval ammunition, aviation sorties, fuel, sleep and maintenance; do not grant time extension for free.
If battlefield possession changes, recompute recovery of tanks, guns, wounded, documents and wrecks for both sides.
If an amphibious assault timetable changes by hours, recheck tides, daylight, beach congestion, naval gunfire windows, CAP cycles and unloading rather than moving only infantry clocks.
CATCHPOLE_specific_checks: US carrier and CVE/CVL allocation after HAILSTONE split
fast battleship/cruiser/destroyer gunfire availability and ammunition expenditure
pre-invasion bombardment effectiveness versus dispersed Japanese positions
Japanese coast-defense/artillery observation and fire-control quality
radar warning and any surviving precision AA/fire-direction assets
night infiltration windows if Engebi/Eniwetok/Parry resistance extends across sunset
submarine/ASW activity on transport and carrier-screen approaches
landing-craft losses/traffic jams and their effect on armor/artillery landing time
engineer crater/obstacle clearance and runway/road repair
airfield seizure timing and subsequent fighter/ASW operating availability
promotion_rule: No campaign closeout is promoted unless every materially relevant domain has either been adjudicated or explicitly marked NOT MATERIAL / NO PHYSICAL PRESENCE.
